channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Owono enduring ‘hardest days of my life’ after De Miguel death
item.description: Tenerife striker De Miguel died on Tuesday as a result of injuries from a collision with FC Andorra goalkeeper Owono.

item.title: Photos: Iran marks US embassy takeover with rallies against US, Israel
item.description: Tehran rallies see slogans, flag burnings and claims of US-Israeli defeats amid historic embassy takeover anniversary.

item.title: Ukrainian strikes kill three in Russia’s Belgorod region
item.description: Russian strikes also cut power to Ukrainian cities as Moscow claims 700 Ukrainian drones downed across multiple regions.

item.title: No regrets: Trump says Iran war justified despite polls drubbing
item.description: Trump acknowledges Iran war played role in defeats but says he would launch it again.

item.title: Iranian leaders welcome US midterms, but Trump may still attack
item.description: Tehran views midterm results as a rejection of Trump's 'war on Iran', signalling US frustration with foreign policy.

item.title: Iran’s Khamenei warns Trump loss at polls won’t end US hostility
item.description: Iranian supreme leader says US policy won't change amid Tehran 'Fight Against Global Arrogance' day rallies

item.title: Can Democrats stop Iran war, reverse Trump’s tariffs after midterms win?
item.description: Democrats can block Trump's legislative agenda, launch investigations but don't have the numbers to override his veto.

item.title: Trump admits Iran war hurt Republican vote, vows to veto ‘insane’ bills
item.description: US President Donald Trump has admitted that the war on Iran contributed to Republican losses in the midterm elections.

item.title: Israel's president begins consultations with parties after election deadlock
item.description: Herzog warns politicians that "not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled" if they want to avoid another election.

item.title: Iran's chief negotiator says Americans voted 'no to war'
item.description: "We endorse this message," Mohammed Bagher Ghalibaf says, as Donald Trump acknowledges the conflict's role in the Republican Party's defeat.
